source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: Those who disbelieved among the Jews, Christians and polytheists would not abandon their disbelief until the sign promised to them in the earlier scriptures came to them.
tafsir.muyassar-2: It is the Messenger of God, Muhammad ﷺ, reciting a Quran in purified scrolls.
tafsir.muyassar-3: In those scrolls are true reports and just commands that guide to the truth and to a straight path.
tafsir.muyassar-4: Those who were given the Book among the Jews and Christians did not differ about Muhammad ﷺ being a true messenger, because they found his description in their scripture, except after they clearly recognized that he was the Prophet promised to them in the Torah and the Gospel. They were united on the truth of his prophethood, but when he was sent they split: some believed in him and some denied his prophethood out of transgression and envy.
tafsir.muyassar-5: In all the laws they were commanded only to worship God alone, seeking His countenance, turning away from polytheism to faith, to establish prayer and pay zakat; and that is the upright religion, which is Islam.
tafsir.muyassar-6: Those who disbelieved among the Jews, Christians and polytheists will have the punishment of the Fire of Hell, abiding therein; they are the worst of creation.
tafsir.muyassar-7: Those who believed in God, followed His Messenger and did righteous deeds — they are the best of creation.
tafsir.muyassar-8: Their reward with their Lord on the Day of Resurrection is gardens of residence and permanence, of utmost beauty, beneath whose palaces and trees rivers flow, abiding therein forever. God is pleased with them and accepts their righteous deeds, and they are pleased with Him for the honors He has prepared for them. That good reward is for whoever fears God and avoids disobeying Him.
